other formal: datatype 'a tree = Leaf | Node "'a tree" 'a "'a tree"

formal function definitions.mirror:
fun mirror :: "'a tree ⇒ 'a tree" where
  "mirror Leaf = Leaf" |
  "mirror (Node (l) (x) (r)) = (Node (mirror r) (x) (mirror l))"

formal theorem statement: theorem Leaf_mirror: "Leaf = mirror t ⟷ t = Leaf"
